result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign for simple, affordable e-signatures**, or **DocuSign if you want a more established, feature-rich business solution**\.

However, the best choice depends on how many contracts you send, whether you need reusable templates, and whether you want clients to sign documents without creating an account.

Here are the five platforms I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

- Easy to use and set up.
- Reusable document templates.
- Signing reminders and audit trails.
- Good integration with Dropbox and other business tools.

Best for: Small businesses sending standard contracts, agreements and forms.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best for business features)

- Well-established and widely recognised.
- Document templates and signing workflows.
- Strong integrations with CRM and business software.
- Useful tracking and authentication features.

Best for: Businesses expecting to grow or manage more complex agreements.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

- Create professional proposals and contracts.
- Templates and document automation.
- Track when clients open and sign documents.
- Sales and payment workflow features.

Best for: Businesses sending quotes, proposals and customer contracts.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent PDF editing and signing.
- Professional document management.
- Integration with Microsoft and Adobe products.
- Good for businesses already using Acrobat.

Best for: Businesses that regularly create, edit and sign PDFs.

[Visit Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/sign.html)

---

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. SignWell**

- Simple interface.
- Reusable templates.
- Signing reminders and audit trails.
- Affordable entry-level options.

Best for: Sole traders and small businesses wanting straightforward signing without unnecessary complexity.

[Visit SignWell](https://www.signwell.com/)

## Quick comparison

| Software | Main advantage | Indicative starting price |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Simple signing | US\$15/month |
| DocuSign | Business features | US\$11/month |
| PandaDoc | Proposals and contracts | US\$19/user/month |
| Adobe Sign | PDF management | US\$16.99/month |
| SignWell | Budget-friendly | US\$10/month |


Indicative published prices in USD, generally based on annual billing. Plans, limits and Australian pricing may differ. Sources: [helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.helprange.com](https://www.helprange.com/e-signature-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for before buying

For a small business, I'd prioritise\:

1. **Unlimited or generous signing limits** – avoid paying extra every time you send a contract.
2. **Reusable templates** – create a contract once and reuse it.
3. **Automatic reminders** – chase unsigned agreements automatically.
4. **Audit trails** – retain evidence of who signed and when.
5. **Multiple signatories** – allow customers, employees or suppliers to sign the same document.
6. **Australian legal suitability** – check that the signature method meets the requirements for the particular document under applicable Australian law.

## My recommendation

I'd start by comparing Dropbox Sign and DocuSign. They're both strong options, but you may not need the extra complexity of DocuSign if you're a small operation.

## A question to narrow it down

What type of small business are you running?

search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
